Name: Noospheric Data-Tether
Effect: Required to perceive and utilise the noosphere. Connects to the Tech-Adept’s Cyber Mantle and Cranial Circuitry. Connecting to a noosphere takes an action and a successful Challenging (+0) Discipline (Composure) Test; on failure, you can try again on a subsequent turn. Adeptus Mechanicus Player’s Guide, pp. 94, 97–98, 130–131.
